matchups.preview: Rilind's about to learn the hard way that drafting three tight ends in the first six rounds doesn't constitute a "strategy," it's a cry for help. Rob's rolling in here with what looks like a reasonable roster, which means he'll find a creative new way to bench his studs and stream waiver wire garbage into a loss by Sunday night.

Jetmir and Peter are rolling out what looks like a fantasy football team assembled by throwing darts at a board, while Adam's just sitting there waiting to exploit whatever defensive catastrophe those two cooked up. This is going to be ugly watching two guys who probably spent their draft picks like they were playing Madden on rookie difficulty, and Adam's about to remind them what actual roster construction looks like.

Ilir's about to learn what it means to actually manage a team when Rinor rolls in with a roster that didn't get drafted by someone having a stroke. Watch as Ilir's "strategy" of reaching for hype gets absolutely dismantled by someone who knows how to build depth—this is going to be a bloodbath before either of them have an excuse.

Veton's about to learn that drafting a defense in Round 4 doesn't make up for whatever the fuck he was thinking at running back, while Arben's "hot take" sleeper picks are about to look as washed as his playoff hopes by Week 3. This matchup is basically two guys arguing about who fucked up their prep more, and honestly, we're all just here to watch the carnage unfold.

Ben's probably still high on whatever kool-aid made him reach for a RB in the third round when he should've been stacking WR, while Nori's out here hoping last year's late-round sleepers magically become relevant again—spoiler alert, they won't. This is gonna be a masterclass in how two completely different types of terrible can still somehow both lose.
